title: fix(app-shell): a Studio pillar whose draft load is cancelled never clears its spinner — a report leaf opened while the first leaf loads leaves the Interfaces canvas on "Loading…"
body:
Sub-issue of objectui#11293. This card carries the Studio canvas race that keeps PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11323's `Test (shard 2/8)` red. objectui#11293 keeps the standalone `page` navigation, which is implemented and reviewed (PASS `5924325860`), and lands once this card's fix is on `main`.

Filing-gate category: ① a defect, class (a). The `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) filed it from objectui#11293's patch round 2 report (`out_of_scope_findings[0]`). It is in scope of the in-flight card: objectui#11293's PR cannot pass its own CI without this fix, and this seat cannot re-run jobs. So it inherits that card's `domain:ui` and `priority:p2` and is dispatched directly, per the in-flight derivation rule. Triage's sweep reads it after the fact.

Dedup: among the 600 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (read through REST on 2026-10-01 and grepped locally), `canvasFrame`, `draftLoaded`, `setLoading`, `isEditable` and stuck-spinner wording match only the closed load-window family: objectui#11272 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11296), objectui#11232 and objectui#11203. None of them names a cancelled load's `loading` flag.

## Measured

- **CI:** job `110206411237`, `Test (shard 2/8)` on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11323's head `852d32f164`. The failure is in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.canvasFrame.test.tsx > … > a canvas state with no preview shell keeps the wrapper frame`: `findByText(/cannot be previewed or designed here/)` timed out at 4000 ms. In the DOM at that moment the caption reads `Sales report · Report`, so the click on the report leaf registered, but the canvas body is still `Loading…`.
- **Deterministic probe**, run by the objectui#11293 dev on `main` `be52115224` and on the PR head, with byte-identical results on both. It mounts the real `InterfacesPillar` with the test's mocks and makes the dashboard leaf's `layered` call wait on a gate:

| case | canvas after the click | canvas after the gate opens |
|:--|:--|:--|
| click the report leaf while the first leaf's (`customer_dashboard`) load is pending | `Loading…` | **`Loading…`, stuck** |
| control: click the report leaf after the dashboard grid rendered | the "cannot be previewed or designed here" empty state | n/a |

- Repeated runs of the test file pass at rest (20/20 on the head, 20/20 on `main`) and under 6-way load (24/24 each). The window is narrow, which is why only a slow shard (import 1402 s) hit it.
- The console UI itself was not exercised. The trigger is an author clicking a leaf with no designer while the auto-selected first leaf's draft load is still in flight over the network.

## The cause (read at source, `main` `5262f7dd3f`)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the `InterfacesPillar` draft-load effect (about `:2236`–`:2286`):
- An editable leaf's load calls `setLoading(true)` (about `:2251`). It clears the flag only in `finally { if (!cancelled) setLoading(false) }` (about `:2280`).
- Opening a leaf with `!isEditable` runs the cleanup first, which sets `cancelled = true`. Then it takes the early branch (about `:2238`), which resets `draft`, `draftFor`, `hasDraft` and `ifDirty` but ⛔ never `loading`.
- The canvas's `loading || !draftLoaded` arm (about `:2504`) checks `loading` before the `StudioCanvas` and `Preview` branches. The spinner therefore stays until another editable leaf is opened.
- This predates objectui#11272. Before PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11296 the arm read `loading ?` and stuck the same way; the `if (!cancelled)` guard is older.

## The family: every pillar's cancelled load (enumeration pin)

The same "cancel the load, then return without a load of your own" shape. Only the first site is measured:

| pillar | effect (about) | early return that runs after a cancel | reach |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `InterfacesPillar` | `:2236`–`:2286` | `!current \|\| !isEditable` (a report or other no-designer leaf; an `object` studio-canvas leaf takes the same branch) | **measured** (the probe above) |
| `DataPillar` | `:3329`–`:3377` | `loadedNameRef.current === loadKey`: a `client` identity change while an object's load is pending cancels the load, and the re-run bails on the same key | read at source, not measured |
| `AutomationsPillar` | `:4478`–`:4510` | `!current` (a deselect while a flow loads) | read at source, not measured; with no leaf the canvas may not show the spinner |

## Direction (the seat's, for the dispatched dev)

- **One rule for the family:** a pillar whose load was cancelled without a replacement load never leaves `loading` raised. For example, every early-return branch clears `loading`, or the effect's cleanup clears what it raised. Choose one shape and apply it to all three sites. ⛔ No per-site variants.
- ⛔ No timeout raise in `canvasFrame.test.tsx`. ⛔ No `heavyDomTests` entry. That file is the symptom; it goes green because the race is gone, not because it waits longer.
- **Pins:**
  - the gated probe above as a committed test (red first on `main`, green after);
  - one row per enumerated site, or a written reason the site cannot be reached through the component;
  - the control row (a click after the load settles) stays green.
- `packages/app-shell` `patch` changeset.

Dedupe words: `StudioDesignSurface loading stuck` · `interfaces pillar canvas spinner never clears` · `canvasFrame flaky no preview shell` · `draft load cancelled setLoading finally` · `isEditable early return loading`
